LOGINS.HINT: Only users who hold the oum.admin permission company-wide can sign in to this admin. The session is an httpOnly oum_token cookie.

LANGUAGES.CHOOSE: Choose a language. The choice is stored in the oum_locale cookie.

HOMEPAGE.INTRO: Admin UI for users, groups, scopes and the permissions they hold. The browser uses REST; integrating apps ask Check over gRPC.
HOMEPAGE.FEATURE_USERS: Create users and groups, and put users into groups
HOMEPAGE.FEATURE_RIGHTS: Grant a permission to a user or a group, company-wide or at one scope
HOMEPAGE.FEATURE_SCOPES: Arrange scopes in a tree; a grant at a scope applies to everything below it
HOMEPAGE.FEATURE_OVERVIEW: See everything a user holds, directly and through groups

ABOUT_PAGE.BODY: Open User Man (oum) keeps users, groups and grants. Apps ask it whether a user may do something, over gRPC. This UI manages the same data over REST.

ACTIONS.CONFIRM_DEACTIVATE: Deactivate this entry? It leaves the lists and can be activated again.
ACTIONS.CONFIRM_REMOVE: Remove this entry permanently? This cannot be undone. Its history stays in the audit log.

USERS.HINT: A user belongs to one company. Signing in needs an active user in an active company; to open this admin the user also needs oum.admin. Deactivating a user keeps its history; remove permanently only after that.
USERS.MFA_SECRET: Scan the QR code with an authenticator app, or type the key. It is shown only once.
USERS.MFA_QR: QR code for the authenticator app
USERS.MFA_RECOVERY: Recovery codes. Give them to the user now; they are shown only once and each works one time.
USERS.MFA_CONFIRM_RESET: Turn off two-step verification for this user? Their sign-ins end at once.

USERGROUPS.HINT: A group is a flat set of users. Its grants apply to every member while the group is active.
USERGROUPS.NO_MEMBERS: No members yet. Add users from the user page.

PERMISSIONS.HINT: A permission is a name your apps check, such as invoice.approve. Names are lowercase, dotted, and unique per company. A deactivated permission stops counting in checks.

APPLICATIONS.HINT: An application signs its users in through oum (OpenID Connect). It belongs to one company, and only that company's users can sign in to it. Deactivating it stops new sign-ins and token refreshes.
APPLICATIONS.SECRET_ONCE: Copy the secret now. It is shown only once and cannot be read again.
APPLICATIONS.CONFIRM_ROTATE: Replace the secret? The old one stops working at once, so update the application first or right after.

SCOPES.HINT: A scope is a place in your own tree, such as a region or a customer. A grant at a scope applies to the scopes below it. A scope with children cannot be deactivated.

COMPANIES.HINT: Everything belongs to one company, and a check never crosses companies. The company key identifies it to gRPC callers when multi-company mode is on.

HISTORY.TITLE: Change history
HISTORY.SELECT: Select an entry to see its history
